brief: An archival monograph identity that unites the numeral 6, orbital degree (°), and a 6-sided cinema lens aperture into a distinctive mark that works from 16 px browser tabs to high-resolution editorial headers.

concepts.name: The Criterion 6°
concepts.idea: An eccentric-crescent numeral 6 whose lower bowl cradles a 6-sided cinema camera aperture and focal nucleus, paired with an orbital degree ring (°).
rationale: Unites numeral 6 + degree (°) + 6-sided cinema lens aperture + focal node in one unmistakable silhouette.
Two-tone Archival Crimson (#B8292F) and Monograph Ink (#171412) palette integrates seamlessly with the Warm Vellum (#FBF8F2) editorial UI.
Includes a dedicated 16–24 px small-size cut and thinned reversed master so favicons and spine stamps never plug up.

recommendation: Approved final identity system for SixDegrees, complete with horizontal, stacked, symbol, wordmark, small-size, and reversed masters.
